versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֛ח אֶת־גַּ֥ת וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

controles.web: After this, David struck the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
controles.kjv: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
controles.livre: Depois destas coisas aconteceu que Davi feriu aos filisteus, e os humilhou; e tomou Gate e suas vilas das mãos dos filisteus.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־מוֹאָ֑ב וַיִּהְי֤וּ מוֹאָב֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֔יד נֹשְׂאֵ֖י מִנְחָֽה׃

controles.web: He struck Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
controles.kjv: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.
controles.livre: Também feriu a Moabe; e os moabitas foram servos de Davi, trazendo-lhe presentes.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־צוֹבָ֖ה חֲמָ֑תָה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהַצִּ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר־פְּרָֽת׃

controles.web: David struck Hadadezer king of Zobah to Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
controles.kjv: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
controles.livre: Assim feriu Davi a Hadadezer, rei de Zobá, em Hamate, quando ele foi assegurar seu domínio até o rio Eufrates.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּלְכֹּד֩ דָּוִ֨יד מִמֶּ֜נּוּ אֶ֣לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּֽרָשִׁ֔ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַיְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָרֶ֔כֶב וַיּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב׃

controles.web: David took from him one thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for one hundred chariots.
controles.kjv: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
controles.livre: E tomou-lhes Davi mil carros, e sete mil a cavalo, e vinte mil homens a pé; e Davi aleijou os cavalos de todos os carros, exceto os de cem carros que deixou.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק לַעְז֕וֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים־וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck of the Syrians twenty-two thousand men.
controles.kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
controles.livre: E vindo os sírios de Damasco em ajuda de Hadadezer, rei de Zobá, Davi feriu dos sírios vinte e dois mil homens.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק וַיְהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְדָוִ֔יד עֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ לְדָוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
controles.kjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria–damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
controles.livre: E pôs Davi guarnição na Síria de Damasco, e os sírios foram feitos servos de Davi, trazendo-lhe presentes; porque o SENHOR salvava a Davi por onde quer que fosse.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗יד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ עַ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

controles.web: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Tomou também Davi os escudos de ouro que levavam os servos de Hadadezer, e trouxe-os a Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: וּמִטִּבְחַ֤ת וּמִכּוּן֙ עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֔זֶר לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד בָּ֣הּ׀ עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת־יָ֤ם הַנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ וְאֶת־הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת כְּלֵ֥י הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ

controles.web: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much brass, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
controles.kjv: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
controles.livre: Assim de Tibate e de Cum, cidades de Hadadezer, Davi tomou muito bronze, de que Salomão fez o mar de bronze, as colunas, e vasos de bronze.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע תֹּ֖עוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֲמָ֑ת כִּ֚י הִכָּ֣ה דָוִ֔יד אֶת־כָּל־חֵ֖יל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־צוֹבָֽה׃

controles.web: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
controles.kjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
controles.livre: E ouvindo Toú, rei de Hamate, que Davi havia defeito todo o exército de Hadadezer, rei de Zobá,

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֶת־הֲדֽוֹרָם־בְּנ֣וֹ אֶל־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־דָּ֠וִיד לשאול־ל֨וֹ לְשָׁל֜וֹם וּֽלְבָרֲכ֗וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם בַּהֲדַדְעֶ֨זֶר֙ וַיַּכֵּ֔הוּ כִּי־אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עוּ הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וְכֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to Greet him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou;) and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
controles.kjv: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
controles.livre: Enviou seu filho Hdorão ao rei Davi para saudar-lhe e para bendizer-lhe por haver guerreado com Hadadezer, e haver lhe vencido; porque Toú tinha guerra com Hadadezer. Enviou-lhe também toda sorte de artigos de ouro, de prata e de metal;

versos.hebraico: גַּם־אֹתָ֗ם הִקְדִּ֞ישׁ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לַיהוָ֔ה עִם־הַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ וְהַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשָׂ֖א מִכָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מֵֽאֱד֤וֹם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵֽק׃

controles.web: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
controles.kjv: Them also king David dedicated unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
controles.livre: os quais o rei Davi dedicou a o SENHOR, com a prata e ouro que havia tomado de todas as nações, de Edom, de Moabe, dos filhos de Amom, dos filisteus, e de Amaleque.

versos.hebraico: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֗ה הִכָּ֤ה אֶת־אֱדוֹם֙ בְּגֵ֣יא הַמֶּ֔לַח שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt eighteen thousand.
controles.kjv: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
controles.livre: Além disso Abisai, filho de Zeruia, feriu no vale do sal dezoito mil edomitas.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם בֶּֽאֱדוֹם֙ נְצִיבִ֔ים וַיִּהְי֥וּ כָל־אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑יד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־דָּוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃

controles.web: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
controles.kjv: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
controles.livre: E pôs guarnições em Edom, e todos os edomitas foram servos de Davi; porque o SENHOR guardava a Davi por onde quer que fosse.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖יד עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֗י עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכָל־עַמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness to all his people.
controles.kjv: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
controles.livre: E reinou Davi sobre todo Israel, e fazia juízo e justiça a todo seu povo.

versos.hebraico: וְיוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל־הַצָּבָ֑א וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃

controles.web: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
controles.kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
controles.livre: E Joabe, filho de Zeruia, era general do exército; e Josafá filho de Ailude, cronista;

versos.hebraico: וְצָד֧וֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיט֛וּב וַאֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וְשַׁוְשָׁ֖א סוֹפֵֽר׃

controles.web: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
controles.kjv: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
controles.livre: E Zadoque, filho de Aitube, e Abimeleque filho de Abiatar, eram sacerdotes; e Sausa, secretário;

versos.hebraico: וּבְנָיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן־יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע עַל־הַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וּבְנֵי־דָוִ֥יד הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים לְיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ

controles.web: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
controles.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
controles.livre: E Benaia, filho de Joiada, era sobre os quereteus e peleteus; e os filhos de Davi eram os principais próximos do rei.
